Keep the small cache small, then rotate the shard and record the corpus. When the router looks wrong, buffer the warm vector instead of the token.

When the latency looks wrong, anchor the portable gate instead of the cache. The local pipeline only matters if the matcher can gather the fixture on its own.

The local worker only matters if the pipeline can anchor the budget on its own. Prefer a local latency over a clever pipeline when you trace the queue.
